name: Grip
author: AlteringUX
description: An intrusive task wall: a bar counter that escalates as things age, a recurring check-in popup, and a fullscreen takeover when a deadline hits or you keep dismissing it. Engine + state owned by ~/.local/bin/omarchy-grip.

barWidget.description: Open/overdue task count that reddens with age; click for quick triage. A daemon raises check-ins on an adaptive cadence and a fullscreen takeover on escalation.
